description: The vent is so full of lint it could knit a sweater. Also: fire hazard.
option_1: Vacuum it and keep the old foil hose
option_2: Replace it with rigid metal duct

description: Something is chirping inside the outside vent cap. You have tenants.
option_1: Poke them out with a broom handle
option_2: Wait until they leave, then fit a vent guard
option_3: Hire wildlife removal and redo the siding

description: Behind the dryer is a yellow gas line, not just a plug.
option_1: Yank it out of the way
option_2: Shut off the gas valve and move it gently
option_3: Convert the whole house to electric

description: The duct snakes 40 feet with six bends. Your dryer is blowing into a labyrinth.
option_1: Reroute it on a shorter path outside

description: The old joints are held together with duct tape. Ironically, duct tape is not for ducts.
option_3: Replace every duct in the basement
